cases.title: Normalize a dataset
cases.goal: Find a reusable transformation that converts each input x into 3x + 2.
cases.acceptance: Exact output on unseen negative, zero, repeated and large integer inputs.

cases.title: Reconcile eligible amounts
cases.goal: Keep non-negative amounts and return their sum as a one-element array.
cases.acceptance: Exact totals, including empty inputs, duplicates, zero and all-negative batches.

cases.title: Clean a product catalog
cases.goal: Return the unique numeric identifiers in ascending order.
cases.acceptance: Exact sorted unique output, including empty lists, repeated identifiers and negative identifiers.
